card.name: Words before risk or dose terms
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" right after verbs like increases, reduce, affect or based on, just before a risk, dose or metabolism term. Also fires inside lab and measurement terms such as eGFR, CYP3A4 and ITLC, and at a closing parenthesis after a CLcr value.

modes.label: "the" after effect verbs
modes.description: The word "the" after verbs like increases, reduce, affect or based on, in drug label warnings and dosing text.
modes.example: WARNING: (A) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF DABIGATRAN ETEXILATE CAPSULES INCREASES<< THE>> RISK OF THROMBOTIC EVENTS

modes.label: Inside lab and enzyme terms
modes.description: Partway through renal function, enzyme or chromatography abbreviations, or at the bracket closing a kidney function value.
modes.example: CYP<<3>>A4 inducers can decrease the plasma
